summary: Settings includes Update, with release notes and a small notice.

changes.title: Update
changes.detail: Settings → Update lists the installed build and the features and changes published with a release.

changes.title: Auto update
changes.detail: Auto update checks when Ronic OS opens. A newer release, or notes you have not seen for this build, shows a small notice.

changes.title: Manual update
changes.detail: Manual update waits until you press Check for updates. The notice appears when that check finds a release you have not dismissed.
